text:
emma_support: P1 customer (Acme.Health) reporting 400 on function invoke 'fetch_patient_summary'. They say it started after the 2025-03-15 deploy. Repro steps + logs below. Assigning to oncall.
jordan_oncall: ack — can you paste the exact request body and the error payload?
emma_support: Sanitized payload below (customer redacted API key):
```
POST /v1/invoke
{
  "function": "fetch_patient_summary",
  "args": {
    "patient_id": "acme-123",
    "filters": [{"since": "2025-01-01"}]
  }
}
```
response: 400 Bad Request
```
{"error":"schema_validation_failed","details":"expected object for 'filters', got array"}
```
emma_support: Customer says this used to work last week with identical payload.
jordan_oncall: Checking runtime logs now — I see schema.validate(..., strict=true) calls around the error. That strict flag wasn't there previously.
lina_ml: We merged PR abc123 on 2025-03-15 that tightened function args to match the published YAML schema. It enforces exact types (no coercion). Might be the culprit — some customers pass arrays where we accepted objects via coercion before. I'll look into the eval failures.
sam_platform: CI: nightly/golden-toolcalls job #4521 shows 3 failing golden tests including fetch_patient_summary_test. Failure output indicates actual tool call args differ by type from golden expected.
nana_qe: CI snippet pasted: 
```
FAIL tests/golden/fetch_patient_summary.test.js
Expected:
{"filters": {"since":"2025-01-01"}}
Actual:
{"filters": [{"since":"2025-01-01"}]}
```
sam_platform: The golden harness asserts deep equality between actual tool_call.args and the golden expected_args. If the runtime started coercing to arrays or vice versa, that will cause the golden checks to fail — regression.
lina_ml: Two hypotheses: 1) the model/tool-selection or prompt signal changed such that the model returns a list for filters now; 2) our serializer/coercion layer changed in abc123 (I remember touching arg normalization). I'll grep the diff.
jordan_oncall: Can you reproduce locally against a canary? If we can repro, we can rollback.
emma_support: Repro curl I ran against canary: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/call -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"fn":"fetch_patient_summary","args":{"patient_id":"acme-123","filters":[{"since":"2025-01-01"}]}}'
```
Response: same 400 with schema_validation_failed.
jordan_oncall: I reproduced locally against the canary runtime — same 400. So this is server-side strict validation.
lina_ml: I inspected commit abc123: the change toggled "accept_coercion: false" in runtime/arg_normalizer and added schema strictness. That explains it. We didn't add a migration for fields that historically accepted arrays.
sam_platform: Opening incident ticket IN-2025-043 (P1) and paging infra for rollback. CI evidence attached (job 4521, test diffs).
deploy-bot: rollback started for service inference-runtime@release-2025-03-15 -> in_progress (rollback id rb-2025-03-15-01).
deploy-bot: rollback completed for inference-runtime at 1923456805 (rolled back to release-2025-03-10).
jordan_oncall: Re-tested the exact customer payload against rolled-back runtime — now returns 200 and the toolcall runs.
emma_support: Customer confirmed their workflow is working again. Provided them temporary note: we rolled back a schema-strict change and will follow up with a permanent fix.
lina_ml: Plan of action: 1) revert strictness for now (done via rollback), 2) add migration layer that coerces arrays->object for legacy fields (filters), 3) add unit tests + golden CI test that exercises both shapes, 4) update schema docs to call out accepted shapes, 5) reintroduce strict mode behind a rollout flag after opt-in.
nana_qe: I'll add a golden-prompt test that includes a case where the model returns an array for filters and assert the runtime normalizes it to the canonical object form. I'll also add a CI gate so the golden-suite runs against canary before rollout.
sam_platform: Created PR #8432 to add CI golden test and a regression test that fails when coercion changes. Tagging as regression and adding changelog note.
emma_support: Notifying customer success and adding a follow-up message to the customer timeline. Closing the escalation once PR merges.
jordan_oncall: Monitoring for related incidents; adding watch on nightly/golden-toolcalls job.
emma_support: thanks all :thumbsup:
